summary: List Checklist List Inspector Filter Options
description: Returns every distinct user currently assigned as an inspector on inspections in the project, with pagination and optional search. Assignees are resolved by id, so a user who is still assigned is returned even after their project contact is deactivated or they leave the project. The `2.0` version of this endpoint omits those users because its options come from the project directory.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query to filter inspectors by name or company

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Set to 'recycle_bin' to return filter options from deleted inspections

schema.description: Response containing user filter options with login information details

data.description: List of available user filter options

items.description: A user filter option with login information

id.description: The unique identifier of the user

login.description: The email address of the user

name.description: The display name of the user

company_name.description: The company name associated with the user
